name: Follow prompt
summary: Follow pill with a person-plus icon that gets tapped, ripples and turns into Following with a tick.

params.name: clickAt
params.note: frame of the tap, after at

params.name: color
params.note: button colour before the tap; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at
